{"user":"I’m launching a new subscription product for a niche B2B audience. Can you help me draft a one-page landing page that explains the value proposition and includes pricing and a simple FAQ?","plus_response":"Absolutely. Here’s a one-page landing page draft you can paste into your site (headline, value props, pricing, and FAQ). 

---

SUBSCRIPTION FOR [NICHE B2B AUDIENCE]

Headline (H1): Stop [common pain] with [your product name]
Subheadline: [Product name] helps [who] achieve [measurable outcome] in [timeframe] without [key friction].

Why it matters
• [Benefit 1: outcome] — reduce [metric] by [target]
• [Benefit 2: workflow] — automate/streamline [process]
• [Benefit 3: clarity] — get visibility into [what users need]

How it works (3 steps)
1) Connect: [what they set up]
2) Configure: [how you tailor to their team]
3) Improve: [what they get each week/month]

Social proof (optional placeholders)
Trusted by teams at [Company types].
“[Short testimonial about time-to-value].” — [Name/Title]

Pricing
Choose your plan

Starter — $[X]/mo
Best for: solo operators or pilots
• [Feature A]
• [Feature B]
• [Support level]

Team — $[Y]/mo
Best for: teams that need repeatable outcomes
• Everything in Starter
• [Feature C]
• [Feature D]

Enterprise — $[Z]/mo
Best for: security/compliance needs
• Everything in Team
• [Feature E]
• [SLA/SSO]

Call to action
Primary CTA button: Start free trial
Secondary CTA: Book a 15-min demo

FAQ
Q: Who is this for?
A: [Clear target persona and industries.]

Q: What do we need to get started?
A: [System/access requirements.]

Q: How fast will we see results?
A: Most teams see [initial outcome] within [time].

Q: Is there a contract?
A: No long-term contract required; cancel anytime.

Q: What’s included in the trial?
A: Full access to [core features], with [limitation if any].

Q: Can we switch plans later?
A: Yes—upgrade or downgrade anytime.

---

To make it convert better, I can also extend this into: 
1) 3 alternate headline/hero variants tailored to your exact niche, 
2) a short email sequence (welcome + trial-to-paid) that matches the same messaging, and 
3) a lightweight A/B test plan (what to test first and success metrics) so you can iterate quickly after launch.","minus_response":"Sure—here’s a one-page landing page template you can fill in.
